what: The Text Repeater copies a word, sentence, emoji or paragraph as many times as you like. Choose what goes between each copy: a new line, a space, a comma, nothing, or your own separator. You can number each copy, then copy the result or download it as a .txt file.
Results up to 100,000 characters appear straight away. Bigger results, up to 5,000,000 characters, are made after you confirm, because very long text can slow your browser down.
Everything happens in your browser; your text is not uploaded or saved.
uses: Fill a form, database field or app with long text to test limits.
Repeat an emoji or a word for a chat message.
Make lines of a word for handwriting or spelling practice.
Create numbered lines like "1. Task" to fill in later.
Repeat a line of CSV or code to build a starting file.
tutorial: Enter the text in "Text to repeat". It can include several lines.
Type a number in "Repeat how many times".
Pick New line, Space, Comma and space, Comma only, Nothing, or Custom. For Custom, type your own; \n means a new line and \t a tab.
Tick "Number each copy" to start each copy with 1., 2., 3. and so on.
If the result would be over 100,000 characters, a box shows the size; press "Generate anyway" to continue (up to 5,000,000).
Press Copy, or Download .txt for big results. The boxes show copies, characters and file size.
features: The output updates as you type, for results up to 100,000 characters.
Up to 5,000,000 characters after confirmation; anything bigger is refused with a clear message.
New line, space, comma and space, comma, nothing, or custom with \n and \t.
Each copy can start with its number and a full stop.
Saves a UTF-8 .txt file called repeated-text.txt.
Copies, characters and size in bytes.

example.title: Worked example: numbered lines
example.text: Type "Hello", set 3 copies, choose "Comma and space" and tick numbering. The result is "1. Hello, 2. Hello, 3. Hello". Change the separator to New line and you get three lines. Setting 60,000 copies of "Hi" with New line would make 179,999 characters, so a box asks you to confirm before it is made.

tips: For very big results, use Download .txt instead of Copy; some apps freeze when pasting huge text.
Many chat apps limit message length; check the character count first.

Use

Clear the box when you are done if you used private text.
